source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 24 (PDF 215-227), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 24 (Evolution) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Why do individuals with better traits increase in percentage in a population?
(Population mein behtar khususiyaat wale afraad ka feesad kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Faidamand khususiyaat wale jandar agli naslen paida karne ke liye chune jate hain, jab ke nuqsan deh khususiyaat wale naslen paida nahi kar pate. Is liye behtar khususiyaat walon ka feesad barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: organisms with beneficial traits are selected to produce next generations

blocks.prompt:
2 What is creationism?
(Creationism kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Creationism ('theory of intelligent design') ke mutabiq tamam jandar isi tarah banaye gaye jaise aaj hain. Har qisam alag banai gayi aur tareekh mein koi tabdeeli nahi aayi.

book_ref.quote: Creationists claim that each type of organism was created individually

blocks.prompt:
3 What was the idea of spontaneous generation? What happened to it with the progress of science?
(Spontaneous generation ka khayal kya tha? Science ki taraqqi ke saath is ka kya hua?)
blocks.explanation: Qadeem log samajhte the ke jandar be-jaan maadde se ban sakte hain; yeh spontaneous generation tha. Science ki taraqqi ke saath tajrubaat ne ise ghalat sabit kar diya (magar creationism ko radd nahi kar sake).

book_ref.quote: the experiments disproved spontaneous generation but such experiments could not negate creationism

blocks.prompt:
4 Who was Charles Darwin? What was the HMS Beagle voyage?
(Charles Darwin kaun the? HMS Beagle ka safar kya tha?)
blocks.explanation: Charles Darwin (1809-1882) English scientist aur evolution ke jadeed nazariye ke bani the. 1831 mein woh HMS Beagle par scientific muhim mein naturalist ke taur par gaye aur duniya ke gird 5 saal ka safar kiya.

book_ref.quote: Charles Darwin was an English scientists

blocks.prompt:
5 What did Darwin's discovery of rocks with fossils and fossils of extinct mammals suggest?
(Fossils wali chattanon aur naapaid mammals ke fossils ne Darwin ko kya bataya?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Bar-e-azam aur samandar waqt ke saath bohat badle hain aur badal rahe hain.
2. Maazi mein jandar bohat mukhtalif the, yani jandar waqt ke saath badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: These observations suggested that continents and oceans had changed dramatically over time

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between the giant tortoises of different Galápagos islands as observed by Darwin.
(Darwin ke mushahide ke mutabiq Galápagos ke mukhtalif jazeeron ke bare kachhwon mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Darwin ne dekha ke mukhtalif jazeeron ke paude aur janwar bohat mukhtalif the; kachhwon ke khol ki shakal mukhtalif thi.

book_ref.quote: the giant tortoises on one island had saddle-shaped shells, while those on another island had dome-shaped shells

blocks.prompt:
7 What did Darwin conclude from the different beaks of Galápagos finches?
(Galápagos finches ki mukhtalif chonchon se Darwin ne kya nateeja nikala?)
blocks.explanation: Chonchon ke size aur shakal ke farq mukhtalif jazeeron par mukhtalif khurak khane ki adaptations the. Unhon ne socha ke nayi species ka banna aur adaptations qareebi talluq wale amal hain.

book_ref.quote: different species of the common birds i.e., finches had different beaks

blocks.prompt:
8 According to Darwin, how could a new species arise from an ancestral form?
(Darwin ke mutabiq aabai shakal se nayi species kaise ban sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Asal habitat se alag hui population naye mahol ki adaptations batadreej jama karti hai. Kai naslon mein dono populations itni mukhtalif ho jati hain ke alag species kehlati hain.

book_ref.quote: Over many generations, the two populations could become dissimilar enough to be designated as separate species

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain overproduction with the book's example.
(Overproduction ko kitab ki misaal se wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Tamam jandaron ki tolidi salahiyat haqiqat se kahin zyada hai. Maada sea star har mausam taqreeban 10 lakh ande deti hai; agar sab bachay ban jayen to paanch lakh maada, har aik 10 lakh ande, chand naslon mein samandar bhar dein.

book_ref.quote: All organisms have a far greater reproductive potential than is ever realized

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan nuqta yeh hai ke paidaish to bohat hoti hai magar wasail mehdood hain, is liye sab bachay bare nahi ho pate. Isi se 'struggle for survival' shuru hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
10 Why is there a struggle for survival among individuals?
(Afraad mein bacha ki jang kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke wasail jitne bachon ko sahara de sakte hain us se kahin zyada paida hote hain. Nuqsan deh variations wale mar jate ya tolid nahi karte, faidamand variations wale tolid mein kamyab rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Because many more offspring are produced than resources can support

blocks.prompt:
11 Name the three kinds of genetic variations. How do they arise?
(Genetic variations ki teen qismen batayein. Yeh kaise banti hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Genetic variations be-tarteeb mutations se banti hain. Yeh ho sakti hain:
1. Faidamand.
2. Nuqsan deh.
3. Neutral (na faidamand na nuqsan deh).

book_ref.quote: These genetic variations may be advantageous, harmful or neutral

blocks.prompt:
12 What are adaptive traits? What happens to them over generations?
(Adaptive traits kya hain? Naslon ke saath in ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Adaptive traits woh faidamand variations hain jo afraad ko tolid mein kamyab rakhti hain. Yeh agli naslon mein jati hain, jab ke nuqsan deh khususiyaat kam ho kar khatam ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: Adaptive traits are inherited to next generations

blocks.prompt:
13 What was Wallace's role in the theory of natural selection?
(Natural selection ke nazariye mein Wallace ka kya kirdar tha?)
blocks.explanation: Alfred R. Wallace (1823-1913), British naturalist, ne apna milta julta mechanism banaya aur 1858 mein Darwin ko khat likha. Dono nazariye 1858 mein Linnean Society mein pesh hue; Wallace ne nazariya Darwin se mansoob karne par itefaq kiya aur unhein kitab shaya karne par aamada kiya.

book_ref.quote: He convinced Darwin to publish his book “On the Origin of Species”

blocks.prompt:
14 What is Neo-Darwinism? How does it define evolution?
(Neo-Darwinism kya hai? Yeh evolution ki tareef kaise karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neo-Darwinism beesvin sadi ke shuru mein Darwinism ko modern genetics se mila kar bana; yeh Hardy-Weinberg theorem par mabni hai. Is ke mutabiq evolution population mein alleles ki frequency ya gene pool mein tabdeeli hai.

book_ref.quote: a more precise definition of evolution is “a change in the frequency of alleles in a population

blocks.prompt:
15 Who presented the Hardy-Weinberg theorem and when? When does evolution take place according to it?
(Hardy-Weinberg theorem kis ne aur kab pesh kiya? Is ke mutabiq evolution kab hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh 1908 mein English mathematician Godfrey Hardy aur German physician Wilhelm Weinberg ne pesh kiya. Is ke mutabiq agar koi shart (bara size, random mating, hijrat nahi, mutation nahi, genotypes ka barabar bachna aur tolid) poori na ho to evolution hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It states that the frequencies of alleles and genotypes in a large, randomly mating population remain constant

blocks.prompt:
16 Define gene pool and allele frequency with examples.
(Gene pool aur allele frequency ki misaalon ke saath tareef karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Gene pool: population mein kisi khususiyat ke tamam genes ki kul tadaad, maslan phool ke rang ke 1000 genes.
Allele frequency: population mein kisi khaas allele ki tadaad ya nisbat, maslan 1000 mein se 600 laal rang ke genes = 0.6 (60%).

book_ref.quote: Allele (gene) frequency is the number or proportion of a specific allele in the population

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate between allele frequency and genotype frequency.
(Allele frequency aur genotype frequency mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Allele frequency alleles (genes) ginti hai; genotype frequency afraad ginti hai.

book_ref.quote: If 40 out of 100 plants are RR, the genotype frequency of RR is 0.4 (40%)

rows: Population mein kisi khaas allele ki tadaad ya nisbat.
Kisi khaas genotype wale afraad ki tadaad ya nisbat.
Khususiyat ke tamam genes (gene pool) mein se.
Population ke tamam afraad mein se.

blocks.prompt:
18 Write any four conditions for Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.
(Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium ki koi chaar sharaait likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Population ka size bara ho.
2. Mating be-tarteeb (random) ho.
3. Population mein aamad ya rawangi na ho.
4. Mutations na hon (ya aage aur wapas barabar hon); aur tamam genotypes ko bachne aur tolid ka barabar mauqa ho.

book_ref.quote: Individuals must not migrate into or out of the population

blocks.prompt:
19 What is gene flow? How can it change gene frequencies?
(Gene flow kya hai? Yeh gene frequencies kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene flow afraad ki hijrat se gene frequency ki tabdeeli hai. Doosri population se afraad ki aamad naye mutations la sakti hai jo foran gene frequencies badal deti hai (evolution).

book_ref.quote: The entry of individuals from another population can introduce new mutations

blocks.prompt:
20 What is mutational equilibrium? Why does it have no effect on allele frequency?
(Mutational equilibrium kya hai? Is ka allele frequency par asar kyun nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Mutational equilibrium tab hai jab wild-type allele se mutant aur mutant se wapas wild-type mutation barabar hon. Dono aik doosre ko khatam karti hain, is liye asar aisa jaise koi mutation na hui ho. Yeh kam hi hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Mutational equilibrium exists when a mutation from the wild-type allele to a mutant form is balanced

blocks.prompt:
21 Give two reasons why mutations are important for evolution.
(Evolution ke liye mutations ki ahmiyat ki do wajuhaat batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Mutations tamam naye genes ka asal aur variations ka mamba hain jo adaptive ho sakti hain.
2. Yeh yaqeeni banati hain ke variations maujood rahen jo group ko mahol ke jhatkon se behtar bachne dein.

book_ref.quote: Mutations also make sure that variations will be present

blocks.prompt:
22 Explain genetic drift with the book's example.
(Genetic drift ko kitab ki misaal se wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aag khargosh population ko 100 se 10 kar deti hai. Bache hue zyada tar bhoore hain, behtar mutabiq hone ki wajah se nahi balke ittefaq se. Gene frequencies ittefaq se badalti hain aur genetic tanawwo kam ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: a population of rabbits is reduced from 100 to 10 by a fire

blocks.prompt:
23 How do similarities and differences between organisms separated by vast barriers support evolution?
(Bari rukawaton se alag jandaron ki mushabihat aur farq evolution ki taeed kaise karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Wazeh mushabihat mushtarka jadd ki taraf ishara karti hai, jab ke wazeh farq laakhon saal ke alag evolution ka nateeja hain. Kitab ki misaal: African lion aur America ka mountain lion (puma, jo asal sher nahin).

book_ref.quote: African lion is very much similar to mountain lion of America

blocks.prompt:
24 Why are many animals of Australia and Tasmania very different from animals elsewhere?
(Australia aur Tasmania ke bohat se janwar baqi duniya se itne mukhtalif kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke geographic rukawaton se alag jandar milte julte mahol ke bawajood aksar bohat mukhtalif hote hain; in ki alag evolutionary tareekh hai. Maslan wahan kangaroo ki bohat si species bare herbivores hain.

book_ref.quote: Organisms separated by geographical barriers, are often very different in spite of similar environments

blocks.prompt:
25 Why do islands often have relatively few but unique species?
(Jazeeron par aksar kam magar munfarid species kyun hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jazeere par aabadkari aur us ke baad ke evolutionary waqiat ki wajah se, jo wahan pahunchne wale jandaron ko munfarid bana dete hain.

book_ref.quote: due to island colonization and subsequent evolutionary events

blocks.prompt:
26 What do comparative anatomists study? Which two types of evolution does their study reveal?
(Comparative anatomists kya parhte hain? Un ka mutalia kaun si do qisam ki evolution zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh fossils aur zinda jandaron ki banawat parhte hain aur evolutionary rishte batane wali mushabihat dhoondte hain. Un ka mutalia divergent aur convergent evolution zahir karta hai.

book_ref.quote: looking for similarities that could indicate evolutionarily relationships

blocks.prompt:
27 Give examples of the different functions of vertebrate forelimbs that share a common arrangement of bones.
(Aik jaisi haddiyon wale vertebrate aazaa ke mukhtalif kaamon ki misaalen dein.)
blocks.explanation: Urna (parinde aur chamgadar), tairna (whale aur dolphin), daurna (ghora), charhna (darakht ki chhipkali) aur shaakhon se jhoolna.

book_ref.quote: vertebrate appendages have a common arrangement of similar bones

blocks.prompt:
28 What are vestigial structures? Why are they evidence of evolution?
(Vestigial structures kya hain? Yeh evolution ka saboot kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Vestigial structures kamzor bane woh hisse hain jo jandar apni ifadiyat khone ke baad bhi rakhte hain. Kabhi mufeed hisson ki yeh baqiyat tabdeeli yani evolution ka wazeh saboot hain (maslan python mein pelvic haddiyon ki baqiyat).

book_ref.quote: These structures are often poorly developed and are called vestigial structures

blocks.prompt:
29 Name four vestigial structures of the human body and what each is a remnant of.
(Insani jism ki chaar vestigial structures aur un ki asal batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Vermiform appendix: cecum ki baqiyat.
2. Coccyx (dum ki haddi): dum ki baqiyat.
3. Wisdom teeth: teesri daarhen jo aabao paudon ke tissue peesne mein late the.
4. Kaan ke muscles: kam bane aur bekaar.

book_ref.quote: Coccyx or tailbone is the remnant of tail

blocks.prompt:
30 Why do related animals have similar proteins?
(Qareebi janwaron ke proteins milte julte kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Qareebi janwaron ka DNA mushtarka jadd se aane ki wajah se milta julta hai. Chunke DNA proteins ke codes rakhta hai, is liye proteins bhi milte julte hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Because DNA carries the codes for proteins that make up each animal, related animals have similar proteins

blocks.prompt:
31 What is antibiotic resistance? How has it evolved in bacteria?
(Antibiotic resistance kya hai? Bacteria mein yeh kaise bani?)
blocks.explanation: Antibiotic resistance ka matlab hai bacteria antibiotic ke saamne zinda reh sakte hain. Yeh bacterial genes ki mutations se ho sakti hai; natural selection se bana yeh gene agli naslon mein jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A gene for antibiotic resistance which had evolved via natural selection passes to next generations of bacteria

blocks.prompt:
32 When did prokaryotes and eukaryotes originate? Which theory best explains the origin of eukaryotes?
(Prokaryotes aur eukaryotes kab bane? Eukaryotes ki paidaish ki behtareen wazahat kaun si theory karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prokaryotes taqreeban 3.5 arab saal pehle ghair mustahkam mahol mein organic molecules ke reactions se bane. Eukaryotes taqreeban 2 arab saal pehle prokaryotes se bane. Endosymbiotic Theory sab se qabil-e-qubool wazahat hai.

book_ref.quote: The “Endosymbiotic Theory” is the most acceptable theory

blocks.prompt:
33 State the Endosymbiotic Theory.
(Endosymbiotic Theory bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Lynn Margulis ki theory: bare prokaryotes ne chhote prokaryotes nigle magar hazam nahi kiye. Chhote prokaryotes bare cells ke andar rehte rahe aur organelles ban gaye.

book_ref.quote: The small prokaryotes were not digested by the larger ones

blocks.prompt:
34 How did mitochondria and chloroplasts originate according to the Endosymbiotic Theory?
(Endosymbiotic Theory ke mutabiq mitochondria aur chloroplasts kaise bane?)
blocks.explanation:
Mitochondria: aerobic respiration karne wale chhote prokaryotes apne aur bare cell ke liye energy dete the.
Chloroplasts: dhoop se khurak banane wale chhote cells khurak bare cell se baant-te the. Dono ko faida tha (symbiosis).

book_ref.quote: The large and small prokaryotes formed a symbiotic relationship in which both cells benefited

blocks.prompt:
35 What is the Membrane Invagination Theory?
(Membrane Invagination Theory kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ke mutabiq prokaryotic cell ki membrane cytoplasm mein andar ko mur gayi (invaginate hui) aur nucleus aur endoplasmic reticulum jaisi membrane wali structures banin; is se prokaryotic cell eukaryotic cell ban gaya.

book_ref.quote: It gave rise to some membranous structures including nucleus and endoplasmic reticulum

blocks.prompt:
36 Why were eukaryotic cells evolved by endosymbiosis important for the diversity of life?
(Endosymbiosis se bane eukaryotic cells zindagi ke tanawwo ke liye kyun ahem the?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh taqatwar aur efficient the. Is se naye khawas jaise multicellularity, cell specialization aur bara size bane, jo aaj ke janwaron, paudon aur fungi ke tanawwo ki kunji hain.

book_ref.quote: They were the key to the spectacular diversity of animals, plants, and fungi

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate between the reproduction of mitochondria and of eukaryotic cells.
(Mitochondria aur eukaryotic cells ki taqseem mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh farq endosymbiotic theory ka aik saboot hai.

book_ref.quote: In contrast, eukaryotic cells reproduce by mitosis

blocks.prompt:
38 What did Lamarck mean by the use and disuse of organs?
(Lamarck ke 'organs ke istemal aur adam istemal' se kya muraad thi?)
blocks.explanation: Mahol badalne par jandar kuch organs zyada aur kuch kam istemal karta hai. Zyada istemal wale organs taraqqi kar ke mazboot hote hain, aur kam istemal wale kamzor ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: He believed that the organs which are used more frequently are developed and become strong

blocks.prompt:
39 Define acquired characters. What did Lamarck believe about their inheritance?
(Acquired characters ki tareef karein. Lamarck un ki wirasat ke bare mein kya samajhte the?)
blocks.explanation: Acquired characters woh jismani tabdeeliyan hain jo lambe istemal ya adam istemal se hoti hain. Lamarck ke mutabiq yeh aulad mein jati theen aur naslon tak wirasat se jandar ko mahol ke mutabiq badalti theen.

book_ref.quote: Lamarck believed that the characters acquired during the lifetime of an organism were passed on to the offspring

blocks.prompt:
40 According to Lamarck, why did the ancestors of giraffes begin stretching their necks?
(Lamarck ke mutabiq giraffe ke aabao ne gardan kyun khenchna shuru ki?)
blocks.explanation: Giraffe ke aabao ghaas ya chhote paudon ke patte khate the. Mahol badla aur chhote paude na rahe to kuch afraad oonche darakhton ke patton tak pahunchne ke liye gardan khenchne lage.

book_ref.quote: some individuals of the population began stretching their necks to reach the leaves of tall trees
